resources.string: Copy my code (paste it into the newsroom dashboard)
Your tip is on its way
Your tip has been handed over. As soon as the journalist\'s app confirms receipt, your tip number appears here. You don\'t need to do anything.

Changes from the newsroom appear here automatically. Your tip number is only for you: it helps you refer to your tip, it is not needed to log in. There is no deadline for an answer: a journalist may or may not reply.
Scan the journalist\'s QR code. You only do this once — no name, no phone number, no account.
This is not a newsroom code.
This code belongs to another app, not to a newsroom.
The code\'s connection address looks invalid. Ask the journalist for a new code.
This code comes from an outdated version. Ask the journalist for a new code.
Start a new tip with the + button. Each tip is separate: the journalist cannot tell that two tips come from the same phone.
All messages and keys of this tip are deleted from this phone. The journalist keeps the tip. You will no longer be able to read replies to it on this phone.
